Combining this with the flow direction of the river at place Jia in the left figure, it can be known that after the river is affected by the geostrophic deflection force, it deflects to the right side, indicating that this place is located in the Northern Hemisphere. In the left figure, AB is the morning-evening line, and the intersection point of AB and the 40° latitude line is located at the morning line. The question stem gives that the local time at this point is 7 o’clock, that is, the local sunrise time is 7 o’clock. Sunrise later than 6 o’clock indicates that the day length is less than 12 hours, with short days and long nights. Short days and long nights in the Northern Hemisphere correspond to winter. Therefore, the season corresponding to the area shown in the figure is winter.
